results.description:
Loon Lite is a network tool. It is designed to be easy to use even for those who touch network tools for the first time.

Features

- Easy-to-use design for beginners to advanced users
- Support various proxy protocols
    - SS, SSR, VMESS, VLESS, Trojan, HTTP/S, Hysteria2, and more
    - UDP, Fast Open supports 
- Various importing methods
    - Subscription, QR code, URL Scheme, Manual imports 
- Custom DNS settings 
    - Loon Lite can be used as a DNS changer
- Check latency (connection test) function
- 'Always On' can be keep maintained secure VPN
- Notification network changes and anomalies

Privacy

We think very important about your privacy. We do NOT collect any information you use through our app. We do not share or upload to third parties any information that may be obtained in the development of the app.
